The '''Imperial Ninth Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Darth Acina]] summoned the Ninth Fleet when the ''[[Arcanum]]'' was [[Raid on the Arcanum|attacked]].
